cands.name: Bill Partington
cands.bio: Republican incumbent. Attorney and Assistant State Attorney (7th Circuit) since 2007; Ormond Beach City Commissioner 2004-2016 and Mayor 2016-2024. HD 28 representative since Nov 2024.
cands.local_ties: Born in Daytona Beach in 1968; lives in Ormond Beach (Wikipedia).

record.text: Voted to place Amendment 3 (property tax) on the ballot and for HB 991 (proof of citizenship for voter registration).

cands.gaps: Donors and endorsements not found. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.

cands.name: Joe Hannoush
cands.bio: Libertarian, 46, self-employed. Also ran as a Libertarian for HD 25 in an earlier cycle. Platform: school funding that follows the student (about $15,000 per student), end cannabis prohibition, end state chemical spraying, replace property tax with sales tax.
